_meta.name: ash_vault_ui_registry
_meta.description: Rule 46 UI Element Registry - the common reference language for all Ash Prompt Vault panels. Every interactive or displayed element has a stable NODE.SECTION.ELEMENT ID. Change requests reference these IDs; the registry is the single source of truth (Rule 19).
_meta.naming_convention: <NODE>.<SECTION>.<ELEMENT> where NODE is REC (Recorder) | RET (Retrieve) | UPD (Update)
_meta.retirement_policy: Removed elements are marked status:retired with the version - never deleted from the registry.
_meta.change_policy: New elements are registered in the same delivery that introduces them (Rule 46D).

_sections.SOURCE: The source selector + manual entry fields
_sections.EXPORT: The Export DB to JSON button

REC.PROJECT.SELECT.label: Project Dropdown
REC.PROJECT.SELECT.notes: active projects from /ash_vault/projects?active_only=true; '-- Default (Ashtonish) --' = id 0; hidden when recorder_project_enabled=false

_sections.SEARCHCTX: The Search Prompt By selector + the per-mode input area + the search-results navigation
_sections.MODEVALUE: The secondary selector for the active search mode (the Tags/Dimension/Model dropdown etc.)
_sections.NAVROW: The ID navigation row (record hopping) or the search-results navigation row
_sections.INFO: The blue info line (Image # | Prompt # | WC:)
_sections.IMGPOS: The live Image k / N position line

RET.SEARCHCTX.SELECT.label: Search Prompt By

RET.NAVROW.IDBOX.label: ID Input Box
RET.NAVROW.IDBOX.notes: the record ID; clamped to max

RET.NAVROW.RESULTS_ROW.label: Search Results Navigation

RET.IMGPOS.LINE.label: Image Position
RET.IMGPOS.LINE.notes: 'Image k / N' on its own centered line below the preview

RET.DIM.LINE.label: Dimension + Aspect

RET.PARAMS.LINE.label: Generation Parameters
RET.PARAMS.LINE.notes: Sampler | Scheduler | Steps | CFG | Seed | Gen Time

RET.PROJECT.ROW.label: Project Info Row
RET.PROJECT.ROW.notes: 'Project: Name (ID: N) | Client: X | [Archived]'; shown only when the gate is on AND project_id > 0

RET.STRIP.LABEL.label: Filmstrip Title
